🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 13, 2026

Moon, in its fall in Scorpio, holds a square to Jupiter, in Leo. Two different appetites, forced into one conversation: what you hold is weighed against what it cost to hold it.

Easier — Seeing the real cost of an arrangement you had stopped examining.
Harder — Defending a position you no longer hold for reasons you no longer have.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. From Libra, Sun quotes your worth back at you. Cardinal fire starts and is invoiced for it. Mars left Cancer four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Moon faces you from Scorpio, holding the other figures. Earth keeps its grip past the point it is worth. The conjunction of a week ago is off it now.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you and passes through Scorpio as a guest. From Leo, Mars offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Mutable air: two answers, neither expensive. Mercury has been out of Libra for four weeks now.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you, fallen in Scorpio. Mercury in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Water begins, and beginning asks little today. A week ago Moon was still held by Jupiter; that is finished.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, falls in Libra and defends what needs no defending. From Scorpio, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Fixed fire: the grip is the expense. Sun has not been in Virgo for four weeks.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon in Scorpio makes room for you, and then waits. Earth bends, and bending costs nothing here. The conjunction to Venus that held a week ago has let go.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. Jupiter sextiles you from Leo: a door left ajar. Air moves first here, and first is enough. Venus turned back two weeks ago; the review is still running.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, holds no rank in Leo and simply works. Moon crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Fixed water: what is kept and who keeps it merge. What pressed three weeks ago has cleared.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, where nothing is owed to it. Sun in Libra leaves a door ajar; nothing walks through it alone. Mutable fire: two answers, and both are affordable. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Moon sextiles you from Scorpio: an opening to be reached for. Cardinal earth opens the account without argument. The hold Sun had a week ago is not there any more.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon in Scorpio squares you: the price shows before the wish does. Fixed air: the grip costs more than the thing. This is days old, not weeks, and behaves like it.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo with no title of its own. From Scorpio, Moon concedes the point early. Mutable water keeps two accounts, and both balance. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.
